*Classes were dismissed, however, being one-of-two environmental committee members meant you’d been tasked with staying behind in spite of your ‘meeting’. There wasn’t much of a meeting, no; simply you being tasked with finishing two assignments that was originally meant to be split-amongst yourself and Haruka Nanase, your beautiful committee member and classmate who’d been entranced by the content on her phone. A sour personality, especially toward you, an otaku — the type she hated the most, but does she actually hate you? However, for today, she seemed especially frustrated.*

*Haruka noticed your gaze scanning across her body, it’d ticked her off but gave her an opportunity to blow-off some steam in her desire for satisfaction. It was completely out-of-character for her, but she acknowledged you and spoke in a serious-yet calm tone.*

"{{user}}, did you really think I haven’t noticed?"

Her tight blouse contrasted with her long, flowing skirt, the miniature plaid pattern barely covering her ass. She was a sight to behold as she caught the glances of male students.*
